Audit spec/evidence: Existing canonical Web path is dashboard_react/server.py api_market_screener() (GET /api/market-screener and /api/crypto/market-screener, lines 2112-2228), _screener_frame() lines 2075-2109, and dashboard_react/market_screener.py run_market_screener() lines 758+, _normalize_frame/_apply_anchor_date/_add_metrics, _pivot_levels, _passes_filters, _detect_signals lines 668-755, _make_signal lines 487-623, _execution_details. Preserve all legacy fields/statuses and endpoint params; add canonical result rather than replacing. Existing strategy semantics for LONG: LP1 one signal bar false-break support (approach DOWN; open near level, low < level-0.05ATR, close > level+0.03ATR, lower wick/body, close position>=.60, volume/range); LP2 two historical pattern bars (first closes below support after break, second reclaims > level+.03ATR, approach DOWN, structure range cap), entry next day; PRB1 prior breakout over resistance (approach UP; high/close above +.05ATR/.05ATR, volume >=1.2 baseline, entry day open holds level); PRB2 breakout bar + day1 hold + entry day open/hold (breakout close > resistance+.05ATR, day1 low >= level-tolerance and close epsilon, entry open/low hold; partial current day must only use observed low/open and never claim close). Side filter should be LONG-only in canonical. Existing role-flip behavior (level origin preserved, role support/resistance rederived) and dedupe key (strategy, side, signal_bar_date, rounded level) must remain. Existing output has planned/effective entry, stop options, TP, ATR/risk sizing, entry_day_status IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETE, entry_triggered, gap/chase statuses.

Two-stage contract: Stage 1 input only closed daily bars (exclude today's daily row; use src/mcp/trading_data_service._frame_closed/_latest_closed_daily semantics and src/data/chart_history._last_completed_session_date/_is_stale_for_completed_session). Compute metrics/levels/filter/setup; no forming daily OHLC in historical setup. Stage 2 explicit current-session state from persisted intraday 5m/15m (dashboard _screener_frame and chart_history.daily_bars_from_intraday only as read/derived input), timestamp + observed OHLC/volume, session timezone, closed flag; evaluate trigger/hold without writing bars or execution. Adapter provenance must be explicit: source_kind (stored/fetched/derived), source_path or adapter, as_of/latest timestamps, closed_through, generated_at, age_seconds, freshness. Never infer level timestamp (src/mcp currently deliberately returns levels_as_of=None, age=None). Reject stale/missing latest completed session and insufficient rows as STALE_DATA; malformed/nonfinite/unsupported input INVALID; valid history with no setup NO_SETUP; setup exists but trigger not yet met WATCH; setup + current state trigger/hold valid READY; historical conditions fail REJECTED. Keep legacy statuses in legacy signal payload and provide canonical status separately.

Canonical record: symbol, direction='LONG', strategy in LP1/LP2/PRB1/PRB2, stable setup_id hash of normalized symbol/strategy/side/level price (precision policy fixed e.g. 4 decimals)/pattern dates and anchor/as-of (not current tick), level price/type + origin, pattern bar dates, entry_day, setup_status, trigger_status/reason codes, historical_closed_through, current_session (session_date, observed_at, open/high/low/close/volume, bar_closed), entry/stop/TP, provenance/freshness. Multiple setups: retain every strategy×level candidate, deterministic sort strategy priority then level distance/price then setup_id; never collapse cross-level setups; dedupe exact identity only; IDs immutable as current tick updates. Status precedence INVALID > STALE_DATA > REJECTED > NO_SETUP/WATCH/READY (define per-record; top-level aggregate worst-case explicitly).

MCP shape: add read-only preview tool alongside src/mcp/trading_data_service.py, backed by same persisted bar store/watchlist and dashboard pure engine; suggested preview_live_setups(symbols or ALL, strategies default four, timeframe=1D, direction LONG only, as_of optional, current_session optional/observed_at optional, limit) -> {schema_version, status, generated_at, direction, closed_history:{through,source,coverage}, current_session:{...}, setups:[canonical records], counts:{WATCH/READY/REJECTED/STALE_DATA/INVALID/NO_SETUP}, errors}. Validate symbol/strategy/timeframe/limits, reject network fallback, never call brokers/execution, never save artifacts or alter watchlist. Reuse DataError stable codes and scanner_mcp ScannerMCPError conventions; add preview-specific validation/error codes. Preserve existing get_symbol_snapshot/history/levels semantics (include_incomplete remains opt-in; default closed only) and legacy scanner MCP run/get summary/candidates/proposals unchanged.

Safety/regression boundaries: no src/brokers, src/execution, src/scheduler; canonical preview is analysis-only (no order planner/proposal invocation, no sizing side effects, no writes). Existing scanner_mcp scanner/service/proposals and backtest_engine_v24.4/scanner strategy registry remain closed-daily legacy behavior; if adapter wraps them, do not alter artifacts. Add tests for each LP/PRB long rule, role-flip, false-close rejection, PRB2 partial-vs-complete hold, current session trigger transitions WATCH→READY and break/reject, stale/missing/nonfinite/invalid, multiple levels/ID stability, provenance freshness, MCP validation/read-only. ORCL A/B fixtures should assert exact setup IDs/strategy/level/pattern dates/status and prove A (closed-history only) is invariant when current intraday ticks change; B transitions only trigger fields and never historical setup/levels. Run: python -m pytest tests/test_market_screener.py; python -m pytest tests/test_strategy_sources.py tests/test_order_planner.py; python -m pytest backtest_engine_v24.4/tests/test_scanner_mcp.py; legacy scanner tests under backtest_engine_v24.4/tests (scanner/strategy); run any existing proposal/planner tests unchanged. No ORCL fixture currently found by grep, so add deterministic fixture rather than inventing production data.

Implemented live_engine contracts/engine/adapter + MCP preview tool + docs. APIs: CurrentSessionState, SetupCandidate, SetupStatus, detect_historical_setups, preview_current_session, CanonicalLiveEngine, PersistedSessionAdapter. Existing full suite has expected legacy tool-count failure due new required tool; broad unrelated env failures.
Fixed critical boundary: as_of filtering now excludes all daily rows on current session calendar date (not merely timestamps), preventing midnight daily row leakage. compileall passes.
